entities.summary: Fernando Aramburu is a Spanish writer. He is the author of the novel Patria, which deals with terrorism in the Basque Country. His novels and poems have received important prizes: Tusquets, Vargas Llosa NH Prize, National Critics' Prize and National Prize for Narrative Writing.
